title: Cant stop bolus after leaving app
body:
Hi,

when i do a bolus i get a little windows, where i can stop the bolus in between like here:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6a7fe1c3-1cce-4032-bac0-23879a54220c)

But as soon as i leave the app for example to check the weather app and i reopen AAPS the little window is gone and i cant stop the bolus. There is only the little indicator at the bottom.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/73a35788-fa0d-4029-8b48-5b8aaf4e1c22)

AAPS Version 3.3.1.3

comments.body: You can find the injection progression window by hitting the _back_ key of your phone.

@robertrub nice that works, but maybe the little indicator at the bottom should be clickable at all times :)
So maybe i need towrite a feature request :)
